description:
Performance optimization, system monitoring, and CPU stability testing tool for Intel and AMD processors

Quick CPU is a powerful CPU monitoring, performance tuning, and stability testing application designed for both Intel® and AMD® processors. It provides real-time visibility and control over key system parameters such as CPU temperature, power, voltage, frequency, core usage, core parking, performance, voltage, current, and power management features.
The application also includes customizable power plan controls, turbo power limit configuration, core performance ratios, and detailed charts for analyzing workload, thermal distribution, and frequency scaling across all CPU cores. Quick CPU 6.0.0 introduces a dedicated CPU stress and stability test module for validating system stability under various load conditions, with support for per-core/thread load selection and multiple CPU test types. While certain advanced CPU settings (such as Speed Shift and FIVR control) are currently available for Intel CPUs, Quick CPU offers comprehensive functionality for all users looking to optimize performance, improve power efficiency, and validate system reliability.
- Enabled the chart only view for all users
- Added additional application palettes
- Added Effective Clock and Active Effective Clock monitoring for supported AMD Ryzen processors.
- Added SVI3 telemetry support for AMD Ryzen processors.
- Fixed support for Intel Panther Lake processors.
- Added a customizable default chart type (Area, Line or Spline) in application settings.
- Improved CPU core voltage (VID) decoding accuracy for AMD Ryzen Family 19h and 1Ah processors.
- Improved power and energy consumption accuracy for AMD Ryzen Family 19h and 1Ah processors.
- Improved CPU frequency and multiplier reporting for AMD Ryzen Family 19h and 1Ah processors.
- Small bug fixes and improvements.
